The Hillsborough County LGBTQ+ Democratic Caucus proudly invites you to join our June Social & General Membership Meeting on Wednesday, June 11th, held at 1920 Ybor.

Mallory Lewis and her sidekick LAMB CHOP!

title: Bystander Intervention De-escalation Training presented by SURJ MKE
description:
Now more than ever, it’s going to take community to keep each other safe and minimize harm. No one is born with these skills, it takes lifelong learning and practice to keep the tools in your harm reduction toolbox sharp. Whether you’ve attended workshops before or this is your first time, this is the space for you!

Bystander Intervention/De-escalation training will focus on ways to intervene in public instances of racist, sexist, anti-Muslim, anti-Semitic, anti-Trans, and other forms of oppressive interpersonal violence and harassment while considering the safety of all parties. The physical and vocal practice of various strategies is designed to change social norms and encourage people to find ways to interrupt violence and prevent further harm.

This workshop includes a learning segment of tips and strategies, how to document, knowing your rights as an intervener, and practice scenarios constructed on ways to show up and support a diversity of identities through an intersectional lenses, both as the intervener and the person experiencing harm.

Welcome to budget season in the PA General Assembly. Phew, are we here already?

We’ve invited State Reps. Jessica Benham (HD-36, Allegheny County) and Lindsay Powell (HD-21, Allegheny County) to discuss it at length on Thursday, June 12 at 8:30 AM and would love if you’d join us. 

What’s up with the budget anyway?

—There are two types of budgets passed each year: a General Appropriations bill and a Codes bill – we’ll discuss the difference

—After Shapiro’s budget address in February, House and Senate Appropriations committees held budget hearings, which turn into close-door negotiation sessions — we want to know what they’ve been discussing

—Lawmakers typically amend existing bills to fit into the scope of the House or Senate Appropriations committees’ budget legislation

With both Rep. Powell and Rep. Benham sitting on various committees, we’re certain they will offer insights into how legislators are progressing some key issues such as Medicare/Medicaid, transportation, housing, climate change and more.

We look forward to answering questions posted in the chat during this briefing. If you can’t make it or want to send us a question in advance, please email us at info@representpa.org.

This briefing will be hosted by Represent PA’s Executive Director, Erin Belitskus.
